clarifications.md now carries an explicit, dated decision ("Decision on the residual 500 — recorded explicitly (2026-08-24)") naming the mechanism, the options put to the user, the choice made ("Accept and deliver, fully recorded"), and the consequence accepted in quantified terms — verified this is a real project-record entry, not an orchestrator's paraphrase, by reading it directly at clarifications.md:271-295
reachableRegressions: GET /kudos/send intermittently 500s ("Failed to load hashtags: JWT issued at future") on the ordinary, everyday happy path — not an edge case reachable only via a crafted or adversarial request, but the base case for any authenticated user loading the page. Measured at roughly a few percent per run, most recently 1 failure in a 121-test full run. The acceptance of shipping with this is now properly recorded as an explicit, informed decision in clarifications.md:271-295 (mechanism, options considered, and the accepted consequence are all stated), which resolves my earlier process objection about provenance. That the decision is now genuinely on the record changes whether shipping was authorized — it does not change whether the software is defect-free. ID-0 ("GET /kudos/send renders the form when a real Supabase session is present") is a shipped acceptance criterion and it does not reliably hold, which is exactly why it is deliberately absent from acceptanceCovered above rather than echoed to satisfy a matcher. A several-percent failure rate on a core happy path is a live availability defect by any ordinary reading of the term, regardless of the sound business reasons for accepting it. I am treating "properly authorized to ship" and "verified free of reachable regressions" as two different questions, and this verdict answers the second one.

findings.summary: Bounded retry mitigating the GoTrue iat-in-future flake is kept for good reasons (cheap, harmless, preserves the never-render-empty contract) but its own header comment and clarifications.md both state its benefit is unproven; the underlying intermittent 500 on GET /kudos/send remains live and reachable on the ordinary happy path

Residual orphan-row risk (network error mid-insert, or a shape-valid-but-nonexistent hashtag id) remains after the dedupe fix; explicitly recorded and accepted in clarifications.md's fourth-pass session with sound reasoning, narrow blast radius (self-visible only), and no realistic path through normal UI use
